 Trabzonspor - On an impressive winning streak
 Let’s take a closer look at Trabzonspor’s current situation. We will analyse their excellent run of form and recent performances in detail. Additionally, we will examine the probable Trabzonspor vs. SC Freiburg line-ups for this crucial match.
 Recent form
 Trabzonspor are enjoying an outstanding run under Thomas Reis, having won their last seven matches in all competitions . Their recent victories include a 2-0 home win over Besiktas, a 4-3 success away to Caykur Rizespor and a 2-0 triumph against Gaziantep.
 The Turkish side have also made a perfect start to their Conference League campaign. They opened with a 4-2 away victory over KuPS before beating Hearts 2-0 at Papara Park, collecting six points from their first two fixtures.
 Their home form is particularly impressive, with six consecutive victories at Papara Park. Another win on Thursday would extend that sequence to seven and give them a strong platform in the league phase.
 However, Trabzonspor will have to contend with several absences. Aral Simsir, Franculino, Arseniy Batagov, Ruslan Malinovskyi and Okay Yokuslu are expected to miss out. Cihan Canak and goalkeeper Onuralp Cevikkan are also doubts, while Sidny Lopes Cabral is suspended after his dismissal against Hearts.

 SC Freiburg - Back to winning ways
 Let’s take a look at SC Freiburg’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s form, recent results, and key players for this upcoming match.
 Recent form
 Freiburg travel to Turkey after recovering from a difficult spell with consecutive victories. Julian Schuster’s side beat Wolfsburg 3-2 in the DFB-Pokal before recording a 2-1 away win against Augsburg in the Bundesliga. Those results followed three consecutive defeats, including a 3-0 loss away to Monaco in the Conference League and a 3-1 defeat at home to Bayern Munich.
 The German side began their continental campaign with a 3-2 victory over Jablonec but were unable to build on that result in Monaco. They have collected three points from their opening two matches. 
 Their away record in European competition is particularly worrying, with four defeats in their last five continental away fixtures. They will need a much stronger defensive performance to contain Trabzonspor’s attack.
 Freiburg are expected to be without Philipp Treu, who is struggling with an ankle injury, and Florent Muslija, who remains sidelined with a cruciate ligament problem. Vincenzo Grifo, Yuito Suzuki and Jan-Niklas Beste are expected to support Igor Matanović, who has scored in each of Freiburg’s last two matches.

 Predictions for Trabzonspor vs. SC Freiburg - Home Team Advantage
 Trabzonspor enters this European match in exceptional form, riding a six-game winning streak. Their potent attack will likely test the German side early, making “Over 0.5 goals” in the first half a strong possibility.
 SC Freiburg has regained some confidence with recent wins, but their defensive issues persist, especially on the road in Europe. This suggests an open game where a decisive result with “ Over 2.5 goals ” is expected.
 Considering Trabzonspor’s impressive momentum and clear home advantage against a Freiburg side that can be inconsistent, our main prediction is for the Turkish team to win with an “ Asian Handicap of -0.25 “.
